narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on the differences between original-brand and generic (domestic) oral acne medication (Isotretinoin). Dr. Chuang explains that while pricing is the primary difference, some patients report slight efficacy differences in oil control. Ultimately, she emphasizes that both are effective and provides a balanced professional opinion to help patients choose based on their budget and preference, while promoting her clinic.
